title: The strict w-local cover
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, and put $W=A^w$ with its structural map $A\to W$ as in [def-weil-pbc-w-localization]. Write $Z$ for the closed-point subset of $\operatorname{Spec}W$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], which is Zariski closed by [lem-weil-pbc-w-localization-points]. Let
$$
 I=\bigcap_{\mathfrak m\in Z}\mathfrak m\subseteq W
$$
be its vanishing ideal, where the intersection is the unit ideal if $Z$ is empty. Thus $I$ is the radical ideal defining $Z$.

Put $E=W^{\mathrm e}$ with its structural map $\iota:W\to E$ as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-contraction]. Let $IE$ denote the ideal of $E$ generated by $\{\iota(a):a\in I\}$, and put
$$
 T=V(IE)=\{\mathfrak q\in\operatorname{Spec}E:IE\subseteq\mathfrak q\},
 \qquad C_A=E_{[T]},
$$
using the retained localization of the closed subset $T$ in [def-weil-pbc-retained-localization]. Give $C_A$ its $A$-algebra structure by the composite of the structural maps $A\to W\to E\to E_{[T]}$.
